variants.text: The paid School lesson is complete. A short reflection settles the material without changing the lesson transaction or adding another cost.
After the paid lesson, a few minutes remain to put your thoughts in order. You note what became clearer without trying to turn the reflection into a second lesson.
You reread your notes and mark one idea you will still understand tomorrow without extra explanation. That is enough for the lesson to leave a useful trace.
Not everything has to settle immediately. You write down one specific question for the next lesson and leave it open instead of inventing a confident answer on the spot.

choices.label: Continue
choices.text: The lesson is complete; the main note is settled, and the day continues.
